characters.description: Earth's world leader and the Malefic Viper's Chosen. He travels with Sandy to the Moon and detects an unidentified B-grade presence there.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's cosmic-worm companion, able to carry passengers through subspace and navigate by sensing changes in space. Sandy transports Jake safely through the hostile layers around Earth and onward to the Moon for their investigation.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron and remote adviser. He identifies the Lunewood meteorite as a system-planted object and believes the Moon's hidden B-grade is probably unable to leave, giving Jake strategic guidance during the lunar expedition.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: A hostile B-grade plant-undead entity fused around the Moon's core. It attacks Sandy below the surface and reaches Jake through the Lunewood Forest with powerful but incoherent communication.
characters.name: Ghost Vine Sovereign

characters.description: A god who publicly confronts the Star-Seizing Titan and wounds the primordial with the Hero's Sword. The display strengthens his legend and increases the strategic threat surrounding Jake and the Malefic Viper.
characters.name: Yip of Yore

characters.description: Jake's wind-aligned companion. She volunteers to help the Sky Whale survey dangerous beasts and either bring them into Earth's defense effort or neutralize them before the Prima Guardian arrives.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: A level-333 beast coordinating Earth's response to its most dangerous creatures before the Prima Guardian event. Sylphie volunteers to help recruit manageable beasts and neutralize those that remain a threat.
characters.name: Sky Whale

characters.description: An inventor, analyst, and space-travel researcher who studies the lunar threat with Jake. He takes Jake's old Katar apart to use its records in a stronger replacement weapon and continues developing technology for travel beyond Earth.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: Jake's stand-in world leader and Earth's practical political commander. Returning from Nevermore with a mobile witch domain, she resumes planetary administration and begins organizing leaders and defenses for the coming event.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: Miranda's assistant, newly returned from Nevermore as a capable C-grade Lucenti Mage. She supports the renewed effort to coordinate Earth's leadership and serves beside Miranda as preparations for the planetary event accelerate.
characters.name: Lillian

characters.description: A labyrinth-maker who proposes merging the available reward idols into one permanent training complex spanning E-grade through B-grade. Projections and repair clones will oversee the ambitious construction and its later maintenance.
characters.name: Minaga

characters.description: The primordial who facilitates the renewal of Jake and Sylphie's damaged Union Oath. Stormild restores their friendship bond, explains its anti-betrayal condition, and confirms that Sylphie has claimed an authority.
characters.name: Stormild

characters.description: A Vespernat Hive Queen who arrives on Earth with Sandy shortly before the Prima Guardian event.
characters.name: Vesperia

characters.description: Yip of Yore's Chosen and leader of the vast Prima Guardian Alliance. He coordinates hundreds of planets even though his own world appears strong enough to face its crisis without them, making the coalition's larger political purpose uncertain.
characters.name: Ell'Hakan

characters.description: A Risen envoy, curse specialist, and ally of Earth. He returns as the official representative of tens of thousands of Risen seeking a place in the coming campaign, giving his arrival both military and diplomatic importance.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: A Holy Church augur returning to Earth with a Church contingent before the Prima Guardian event.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: A returning power whose destabilized realm is rebuilding as Earth prepares for the Prima Guardian.
characters.name: Fallen King

characters.description: A master swordsman whose clan controls the territory chosen for Labyrinth City and will manage the new settlement.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: A heretic metal and karma mage who returns early from Nevermore with urgent intelligence about Ell'Hakan. Jake and Miranda regard his information as important while remaining wary of his motives, methods, and stability.
characters.name: William

characters.description: A close-combat member of Earth's elite Guardian strike team. Her assigned task is to draw the enemy's attention while the other specialists establish their attacks, placing her at the center of the planned opening engagement.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: Jacob's distant guardian. He joins Jacob in confirming the predicted target area shortly before Earth's Prima Guardian arrives.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: A returning ally who arrives on Earth with members of a Tao sect before the Prima Guardian event.
characters.name: Aaron

characters.description: A Court of Shadows judge who joins Earth's elite Guardian strike team as a fast attacker.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: An investigator who leads inquiries into Earth-based collaborators because many suspects come from his former United Cities Alliance support base.
characters.name: Arthur

characters.description: A ranged combatant assigned to Earth's elite strike team for the immediate attack on the Prima Guardian. She joins the specialists gathered at the predicted impact site while the larger force prepares to contain the surrounding armies.
characters.name: Maria

characters.description: A level-349 composite enemy created under Earth's accelerated Guardian protocol. Its body combines traits and energies drawn from several Primas defeated earlier on the planet.
characters.name: Exalted Prima Guardian

characters.description: An injured world leader and spear fighter fleeing her planet's Honored Prima Guardian. A premature release has killed most of her elite force, and the enemy continues pursuing her through repeated attempts to escape.
characters.name: Oleandra

characters.description: An offworld leader who meets Oleandra after killing her planet's Prima Guardian and identifies himself only as Earth's world leader.
characters.name: Thane

characters.description: Jake's identity becomes known to Oleandra after their meeting, connecting him to the offworld leader who killed her planet's Prima Guardian.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: The elven world's nominal leader and religious intermediary for the Great Bright One. He holds final authority over releasing the planet's Prima Guardian.
characters.name: Voice of the One

characters.description: The elf known as the Voice of the One and the effective leader of a vast unified population. He agrees to release his world's Prima Guardian after judging Jake capable of defeating it.
characters.name: Kindroth

characters.description: An overseer of Earth's returning Risen population. She works with Casper to keep the contingent disciplined as it settles on a self-governed island amid protests and anti-Risen incidents.
characters.name: Priscilla

characters.description: The swordsman known as the Sword Saint. He prepares a painting-based emergency return method before using Arnold's teleporter to travel to another world.
characters.name: Miyamoto

characters.description: A level-306 living calamity that drains color and life from its surroundings. It traps Sylphie and the Fallen King, survives devastating physical wounds, and spreads stronger desolation when injured, turning a direct battle into an escalating environmental disaster.
characters.name: Desolate Child of Loss
